counter_note: Dirty preservation is defined by snapshot_tree differing from source_tree. Per-worktree porcelain counters were discarded after validation because their collection was unreliable; commit/tree identities are authoritative.
unattached_archive_note: Unattached local branches are history-independent archive commits parented on origin/dev. Exact trees are preserved except GitHub-rejected blobs over 100 MiB, which are replaced by byte-exact chunk sets plus reconstruction manifests.
